title: Let's kick off the sprint...
content_text:
Let's kick off the sprint planning session and review our top priorities.
I'm feeling pretty confident about our velocity this quarter, especially with the new automation pipeline.
That said, we're still short-staffed on the QA side, and I worry the release timeline might slip.
To be fair, the client has been flexible so far, but we should flag any risks early.
Let's sync tomorrow morning to finalize the backlog and assign owners.
